name: Plagued Hatchlings
label: Quest
description: Plagued Hatchlings: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Argent Dawn recently learned that the Scourge are creating their own plagued dragonflight! We must stop them -- if the Scourge gain a force of dragons they'll sweep across Azeroth unchecked!
Their necromancers are breeding plagued dragons at the Scholomance, in the middle of Darrowmere Lake.
Go to the Scholomance and kill as many hatchlings as you can... Before they get any bigger!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Get to the Scholomance, friend. Take out those plagued hatchlings before they grow!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend! It'll be a long time before they can grow another clutch of dragons.
